concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payouts-payout-service-internal-fund-transfers-scheduled-fund-transfers]] — 2020-modified, 2026-09-15-captured Payout Service account-to-account sweep guide for direction, roles, account-time-zone cron and amount gates, with separate configuration/execution webhooks; optional examples drift into bank-payout fields.
warnings: Payout Service URL and bank-oriented optional samples do not change the core internal balance-account-to-balance-account operation.
The page names a Transfers API Initiate credential role but uses a Balance Platform Configuration API sweep-create endpoint; preserve both without substituting one authorization for another.
Dynamic description says remittanceForBeneficiary and transferInstrumentId while the core table says referenceForBeneficiary and balanceAccountId.
